proposal: End the Norwegian-club European-qualifier streaming revert-war at its root in scripts/lib/norwegian-rights.js. The deterministic rights map confidently returned Viaplay for /europa|conference/ and TV 2 for /champions/, so it re-derived the WRONG channel on EVERY hourly rebuild for Glimt/Brann/Tromsø qualifier matches — which are sub-licensed FREE to local holders (Direktesport/Amedia/VG TV/VG+ Sport), not the aggregator that holds the competition proper. That silently clobbered the channel verify/research had correctly set, every hour. Two-part fix: (1) norwegianRights() now DECLINES to guess (returns []) for a UEFA club competition in a QUALIFYING round when ev.norwegian is true — so normalizeStreaming keeps the event's own researched Norwegian streaming instead of overwriting it; the generic foreign-vs-foreign qualifier and all group-stage/knockout matches are unchanged (CL→TV 2, EL+UECL→Viaplay). (2) Added `direktesport`/`avisa nordland`/`an.no` to NORWEGIAN_RE so the free local holder survives normalizeStreaming's foreign-channel filter (it was being dropped as 'foreign', which for Tromsø–Cluj — whose only channel is Direktesport — would have emptied streaming entirely). Sharpens an existing lib; adds no machinery; touches no protected path.
evidence: research-log.json (2026-08-10, quality.failures) scored the run −10 for exactly this: 'Glimt/Brann norsk-europacup streaming revert-war (pipeline re-deriver TV 2 Play/Viaplay via norwegian-rights over lokal-holderen Direktesport/AN + VG+ Sport) er flagget i ≥3 kjøringer og fortsatt uløst' and names the durable fix as verify(priorConfirmed) + self-repair(norwegian-rights.js + PLATFORM_SOURCE_TOKENS) — i.e. a code change in this lib.

verify-log.json (2026-08-10) AMENDED Tromsø IL–CFR Cluj because 'Streaming-feltet sa Viaplay (generisk CL-prior) men motsa hendelsens egen provenance+summary, som begge navngir Direktesport', and separately recorded durable learning it could not write to the skill: 'norske klubbers tidlige europakvalik -> Direktesport/Amedia'.

events.json shows the live damage + repeated hand-correction: Bodø/Glimt–Union and Union–Bodø/Glimt provenance.streaming notes read 'Pipeline re-deriver feilaktig TV 2 Play via norwegian-rights /champions/ (revert-war); streaming[] RE-SATT til Direktesport/Avisa Nordland' with a fresh RE-SATT timestamp on 08-05; Apollon–Brann's note: 'Streaming[] var RE-KLOBBET til Viaplay (pipeline re-derivde via /conference/-rettighetskart)'. Meanwhile Brann–Universitatea Cluj currently sits clobbered on Viaplay.

scripts/lib/norwegian-rights.js already CARRIED the knowledge in a comment ('Norwegian clubs' EARLY qualifiers are often sub-licensed free to VG TV / Direktesport / Amedia — the verify agent resolves that per event on top') but returned confident Viaplay/TV 2 anyway, so the map fought verify every hour. The fix makes the code do what the comment already knew.

npm test: 1373 passed (81 files), up from 1368 — 5 new targeted tests: the qualifier carve-out returns [] for CL/EL/UECL qualifiers with norwegian:true; foreign-vs-foreign qualifiers still map to the aggregator (existing behaviour, no norwegian flag); a Norwegian club's CL GROUP stage still maps to TV 2; and normalizeStreaming keeps Direktesport / VG+ Sport / Avisa Nordland while dropping a foreign leftover (ESPN).
notes: Expected effect: research/verify no longer have to re-set the local channel every few hours, the -10 revert-war deduction disappears from the research grader, and Tromsø/Glimt/Brann qualifier rows keep their true free local broadcaster instead of a wrong Viaplay/TV 2.

How we'll know it worked: within a few days research-log.json quality.failures stops citing the 'norsk-europacup streaming revert-war', and events.json provenance.streaming notes for these matches stop accruing new 'RE-SATT/RE-KLOBBET' timestamps.

Scope guard: the carve-out is gated on ev.norwegian AND a qualifying-round marker AND a UEFA club competition, so generic Europa/Conference qualifiers (foreign vs foreign) and all group-stage/knockout matches keep the existing CL→TV 2 / EL+UECL→Viaplay mapping. Already-clobbered stored arrays (e.g. Brann–Cluj on Viaplay) are healed by verify on its next pass; the fix stops FUTURE re-clobbering.
